_note: orphan_record and orphan_vhost: A records land on a collected host where no enabled server block names them (requests reach the default server), and one host carries a vhost file on disk and one enabled vhost with two names that have no record in any collected zone and no wildcard covering their zone. Rows: the DNS and audit runs, every A and CNAME record (a name served through a CNAME alone is not an orphan, so the aliases are needed), the audit events on the records the findings name, both host runs' server_name rows with their .zone and .enabled siblings, the inventory (each host's global addresses) and the export tarballs backup_recent reads. The CNAMEs bring the one proxied alias of a direct apex with them, so the pass also reports that proxy_split here. Cut from sample/bundle.json by scripts/examples.ts.
